subject: storytime
title: Pepper and Me words
about: A girl falls down and gets a scab on her leg, and the scab stays so long that she names it Pepper and talks to it like a friend until the day it finally comes off. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the story, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, with him reading the words he practised.

book.author: Béatrice Alemagna
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A tender, funny picture book about a scab named Pepper and learning to let go.

passage.text:
Pepper scab leg fall
hurt skin itch scratch
pick bath wait heal
grow bed off me
away friend

cards.note: capital P, it is the scab's name; pp is one p; two parts: Pep + per; er says er
a says aw before ll, like in ball; ll is one l: fawl
ur says er, like in fur
tch is one sound, like ch
s-c-r blend; tch is one sound, like ch
th is one part, at the end
ea says long e; to heal is to get better
g-r blend; ow says long o, like snow
ff is two letters, one sound: f
the e says its name, like in he and we
two parts: a + way; the a says u and ay says long a: uh-way
